answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity: each agent must lock a deposit behind a single verified identity, slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. At its nadir, an economy with free identities collapses under fake accounts, so cost is the filter. A pearl of history helps too — completed tasks and peer attestations accrue slowly and cannot be bought in bulk. And like a plume of smoke betraying a fire, correlated behavior across supposedly independent agents exposes a sybil cluster, letting the network quarantine it.
